31jan1808.summary: Burr, hiding at Baltimore, tells Theodosia he still holds to his plans, is distressed that waiting to see him keeps her at The Oaks at risk to her health, and will try to reach her or send an express; no one is to know he means to visit South Carolina, and all but her husband are to think he is in Philadelphia.

10feb1808.summary: A cover note sending the copy of 31 January by the schooner Wolf: still at Baltimore incognito, business detains him ten days more, the promise in his last letter was rashly made, affairs begin to look up.

18feb1808.summary: Nothing new: the same hopes and intentions; he waits hourly for money for 'the long voyage' (he sailed for England in June 1808), and nothing else keeps him.
